Smart Infrastructure We at the Mart Networks Group have been selling Smart Building Infrastructure solutions since 1999, making us one of the leading pioneers in the passive infrastructure business. ​ We provide Certified Testing on installed copper and fiber infrastructure. The Smart building solutions include Fiber & Copper plug n play supporting high bandwidth interconnect in Data centers. ​ Our Data center solutions includes single and multi-rack Micro Data centers and Containment Data centers with intelligent power monitoring, backup power, cooling, Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS) and Data center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) The Data center Networking Portfolio include Data center core switching and Routing from leading global vendors. Cyber Security The Cyber Security portfolio includes Enterprise Firewalls, End point security, Mobile protection, Encryption, Email protection, Network Protection, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Phishing and Security as a service (SaaS) . ​ The Manged and Detection and Response (MDR), Network Detection and response (NDR) and advance Intercept Detection (XDR) provides end to end Cyber security protection . This service provides 24/7 threat detection and response service. ​ We also provide Server workload security platform which protects software and offers true runtime protection at the workload. Physical Security Physical security is essential in protecting homes and businesses.
